passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: One dream is to be a teacher.
phrases.ko: 한 가지 꿈은 선생님이 되는 것이에요.
phrases.zh: 我的一个梦想是当老师。
phrases.py: wǒ de yí gè mèng xiǎng shì dāng lǎo shī。

phrases.en: I want to help a child.
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng bāng zhù yí gè hái zi。

phrases.en: I want to be kind, and I want to be patient.
phrases.ko: 나는 친절하고 싶고, 참을성 있고 싶어요.
phrases.zh: 我想变得善良，也想变得有耐心。
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng biàn de shàn liáng， yě xiǎng biàn de yǒu nài xīn。

phrases.en: I will teach at a school.
phrases.py: wǒ jiāng zài yī suǒ xué xiào jiāo shū。
wǒ xiàn zài nǔ lì xué xí。

phrases.en: The future can be bright, and this is my dream.
phrases.ko: 미래는 밝을 수 있고, 이것이 나의 꿈이에요.
phrases.zh: 将来可以很明亮，这就是我的梦想。
phrases.py: jiāng lái kě yǐ hěn míng liàng， zhè jiù shì wǒ de mèng xiǎng。

phrases.en: A kind teacher helps a child feel safe.
phrases.ko: 친절한 선생님은 아이가 안전하다고 느끼게 도와줘요.
phrases.zh: 善良的老师让孩子觉得安全。
phrases.py: shàn liáng de lǎo shī ràng hái zi jué de ān quán。

phrases.en: I study hard because a dream needs work.
phrases.ko: 꿈에는 노력이 필요해서 나는 열심히 공부해요.
phrases.zh: 梦想需要努力，所以我努力学习。
phrases.py: mèng xiǎng xū yào nǔ lì， suǒ yǐ wǒ nǔ lì xué xí。

phrases.en: I hope the future school is full of smiles.
phrases.zh: 我希望将来的学校充满微笑。
phrases.py: wǒ xī wàng jiāng lái de xué xiào chōng mǎn wēi xiào。

phrases.en: My mother is a teacher, and she is my example.
phrases.zh: 我的妈妈是老师，她是我的榜样。
phrases.py: wǒ de mā mā shì lǎo shī， tā shì wǒ de bǎng yàng。

phrases.en: This dream is patient work, one day at a time.
phrases.ko: 이 꿈은 하루하루의 참을성 있는 일이에요.
phrases.zh: 这个梦想是有耐心的事，一天一天来。
phrases.py: zhè ge mèng xiǎng shì yǒu nài xīn de shì， yī tiān yī tiān lái。

full_passage_spoken: One dream is to be a teacher. I want to help a child. I want to be kind, and I want to be patient. I will teach at a school. I study hard now. The future can be bright, and this is my dream. A kind teacher helps a child feel safe. I study hard because a dream needs work. I hope the future school is full of smiles. My mother is a teacher, and she is my example. This dream is patient work, one day at a time.
topic_pinyin: wǒ de mèng xiǎng（ lǎo shī）
full_passage_zh: 我的一个梦想是当老师。我想帮助一个孩子。我想变得善良，也想变得有耐心。我将在一所学校教书。我现在努力学习。将来可以很明亮，这就是我的梦想。善良的老师让孩子觉得安全。梦想需要努力，所以我努力学习。我希望将来的学校充满微笑。我的妈妈是老师，她是我的榜样。这个梦想是有耐心的事，一天一天来。
